results.title: Nicotine Blues
results.overview: A shy landscape architecture student creates a connection with a classmate through cigarette breaks, until the habit that brings them closer begins to take a toll on his body.

results.title: The Lone Wanderer
results.overview: An old man goes for a walk to a place of peace, but comes into conflict from people that push him to the lowest point he has been  ​​

results.title: Alaska
results.overview: The plan is simple. Leo hides in the suitcase, which Jo puts in the luggage compartment of the bus – full of tourists' suitcases, on its way to the airport... But at 35, Jo realises that it's time to make a change in his life. However, abandoning his sidekick would mean losing his only friend.

results.title: The Sequence
results.overview: After a terrifying and deeply disturbing nightmare, stay-at-home mom Taylor wakes in a panic, convinced that the horrific events she dreamed about must never come to pass. As she prepares for moving day, tension with her husband, Thomas, and son, Mike, only fuels her growing fear. But when eerie details from her nightmare start manifesting in reality, Taylor becomes desperate to alter the course of events, doing everything in her power to prevent her worst fears from coming true.

results.title: Koshedhunga
results.overview: A strong-willed woman defies her father in order to wed her childhood sweetheart, but she faces more antagonism when her new husband leaves the country to find work.

results.title: Devil's Play
results.overview: Iva, a troubled teenager trapped between an abusive stepfather and a distant, deaf mother, finds unexpected salvation in a mysterious boy claiming to be Lucifer, a fallen angel sent to guide her. As she wrestles with faith, madness, and destiny, she is trained for a chilling mission: to assassinate a powerful American televangelist hiding a sinister truth beneath his holy image.

results.title: Nothing to See Here: Watts
results.overview: A groundbreaking documentary created by the community of Watts, California — including rival gang members, police officers, victims of violence, and kids just trying to survive.

results.title: Backbite
results.overview: The classic mean girl with a twist. Three women, one dance competition and not all play fairly. Will friendships prove to be stronger than being popular?

results.title: The Lumineers: Amazon Music Songline
results.overview: The Lumineers recorded 12 all-new versions of fan favorite songs including Ophelia, Stubborn Love, and more for Amazon Music's Songline. Hear the band as you've never heard before, with exclusive behind the scenes on the process of the new album.

results.title: Cement: The Final Brick in the Wall
results.original_title: Cement: The Final Brick in the Wall
results.overview: Cement: The Final Brick in the Wall is an insane love story between and incestuous couple that have been abused as children, now they are on a rampage to hell, raiding drug squads and what not..

results.title: Keepsake
results.overview: Lily wants a divorce, but when her husband traps them both inside his happiest memory of their relationship she must fight to regain control over her life and her future.

results.title: Echoes of the End
results.overview: When touched by death, will you feel more alive?

results.title: Forbidden Feast!
results.overview: Bill and Lewis try out a new dinner spot in this Lunchian horror classic.

results.title: if possible
results.overview: Told through the eyes of Wenzle, an unsung hero tortured by a life of neglect and abuse, we are drawn into a hauntingly abstract dystopian world. Resigned to his daily torment, Wenzle drifts through existence, until a stranger enters his life, igniting hope and revealing a glimpse of a world that might hold beauty after all. Could this be his chance to escape, or is it just another illusion?

results.title: Clint Eastwood : la légende
results.overview: Clint Eastwood made his mark on cinema by abandoning violent action films to turn his attention, behind the camera, to more substantial productions that were praised by critics.

results.title: In a Hail of Bullets
results.overview: In the Dominican Republic, a team of highly skilled thieves carries out a series of increasingly daring heists targeting a powerful criminal empire. But their actions are driven by more than greed, as a personal vendetta fuels their dangerous mission. With the police closing in and a ruthless enemy determined to stop them, the crew must execute their most ambitious robbery yet while fighting to stay one step ahead of both sides.

results.title: Vidrohi
results.overview: A strict Intelligent and brave police officer Karthik knows about clue less series of rapes going on girls in their own houses without their notice by unknown person. He sneaks in to investigate and kick starts a dangerous series of event.

results.title: Universal
results.overview: A couple of academics enjoying a romantic break in a remote log cabin find their stay interrupted by someone who has tracked them down, seeking their help with what could be the biggest discovery in history...

results.title: Children's Day
results.overview: Xuan (8) is struggling to find the perfect outfit for her school’s upcoming Children’s Day celebration. Her sisters are mean, her father authoritarian, her mother busy with the new baby. Xuan tentatively approaches a classmate and makes a new friend.
